name: Azeroth Companion
title: Application Integrity & Player Acceptance Readiness
features: Added an optional, read-only Application Integrity Center in Data & Backup to inspect duplicate interface IDs, navigation routes, archived studio visibility and essential controls.
Created a separate Player Acceptance Checklist for desktop and iPhone, with checkboxes for real-character research, Talent Forge, music and saved-data testing.
Testers can generate and copy a plain-text report locally; no report is automatically uploaded or sent.
Existing backups, original studio controls, character APIs, Talent Forge, gear intelligence, music player and saved data remain unchanged.
Static JavaScript syntax and asset/version consistency checks were completed; live PC, iPhone and Blizzard character acceptance tests are deferred until players are available.
